Its output prepares the property phrase that follows (a determiner plus a gradable/evaluative adjective such as 'a', 'high', 'higher', 'lower', 'greater', 'comparable'), and it is weak on part-whole/genitive 'of' (the size of the building, the opinion of the manager), on coordination or plain object determiners (the girl and the dog, saw a dog), and on 'at' as a verb adverbial (looked at the sky).
